subject: R1 terminated after >=13/20 with no receipt; cause unresolved; no retry; release GPU lease
body: Lane B fallback monitoring through WorkBridge found the single authorized V10R3R1 trainer gone, output namespace present with only sft_work, no adapter artifacts, and no DEV_TRAINING_COMPLETE.json. Project Runner marks Lane A trainer ORPHANED. GPU readback is 0% / 0 MiB. Last live Executor-console observation before connector loss showed step 13/20 complete; this console observation was not separately persisted, so it is recorded as live-observation evidence rather than a durable trainer receipt. Windows Application log contains no matching python/CUDA crash event in the relevant window; Security process-termination audit returned no matching event. Executor final traceback could not be recovered because its connector remains unavailable. Executor tunnel forwarding continued through ~13:03:46 local, so Executor-caused termination is NOT established. Correct incident status is TERMINATED_NO_COMPLETION_RECEIPT_CAUSE_UNRESOLVED. Scientifically, R1 did cross and exceed the predecessor's 4-step boundary (step5 completed and at least step13 was observed), so deterministic immediate post-step4 OOM is falsified; full 20-step executability is still unproven. Frozen attempt_limit=1 means NO SECOND R1 ATTEMPT. Recipe panel remains prohibited/unconsumed. Incident is source-bound on Lane B branch at 2c0892339fb0fbc519f4fd7bc599b4e8724da966. Please ACK incident and release the now-stale Lane A GPU lease; do not restart training implicitly.
